darwin.notes: macOS 1.2.5 build 134: adds Always on Top and resume-from-stop controls, live PLAYHEAD readouts, updated palettes, a single-instance guard, and bounded Shift+Command-drag transfer from streamed audio into an editable Preview (64 MiB cap). Fixes playback after transferring LIMIT fragments and restores rapid short-sample library audition; stale source-start requests no longer interrupt the current sample.

win32.notes: Windows 1.2.5 build 291: speeds up paging through large sample lists and shows loading while results are fetched. Quick Export saves a selected Live Preview region as a unique 32-bit float WAV inside an indexed library, then indexes and adds it to the last-used Project or Collection. Selected indexed files can also be assigned without copying audio. Separate Project and Collection targets persist across restarts. Adds a 2,000-character note to each Project and Collection.
